# Lifecycle table
{: .no_toc }

This is the contribution state machine as defined in `lifecycle.py`: 29 states, 237 transitions with 95 distinct verbs (70 of the transitions are expanded from 5 rules), 1 flag, and 13 retry budgets, plus the operation table with 6 states and 14 transitions. A contribution starts in `queued.idle` (`accept_request`).

Requested Work is identified by its generation, revision, and Work id. A Result that differs in any of them is never folded and never published.

## Triggers

| Trigger | Meaning |
|:--------|:--------|
| `command` | An authorized `/upstreaming` command. Commands that activate or approve work name the exact current revision; stop commands may name a stale one. |
| `observation` | A read-only observation by the collector: fork branch, CI runs, pull requests, review comments, or releases. |
| `result` | A verified native-queue Result folded by reconciliation. A Result is folded only when it matches the current generation, revision, and requested Work; any other Result takes `record_late_effect`. Each Result records its token usage in the events. |
| `operation` | A trusted remote operation receipt and its exact readback. |
| `tick` | A controller decision without new input: Work allocation, a budget charge or exhaustion, a deadline, or the stop after an unexpected error while one contribution was processed. |

## State kinds

| Kind | Meaning |
|:-----|:--------|
| `auto_wait` | Waits for an automatic trigger; the controller acts without a human. A guard that does not hold yet (a worker slot, capacity) keeps the contribution here; there is no separate capacity wait. |
| `work` | Requested Work or a trusted operation is in progress. |
| `human_wait` | A recorded `pending_human_action` names what a human must do; `/upstreaming resume` continues. |
| `gate` | Waits for a human command that starts the next step. |
| `locked` | Write-fenced wait: only the listed exits leave it, and no Work, patch, or branch write happens while here. |
| `generation_end` | The current generation has ended; the record is kept for audit and late-effect reconciliation until a clean restart with `/upstreaming refresh`. |
| `terminal` | No transition leaves this state. |

## States

*Launches* means the controller may allocate Work or launch remote effects from the state, subject to the flags. *Fork writes* means automated writers may write the contribution fork. *Exits* counts the state's own transitions and, after the plus sign, the rule transitions that apply in it.

| State | Kind | Launches | Fork writes | Exits | Description |
|:------|:-----|:---------|:------------|:------|:------------|
| `queued.idle` | `auto_wait` | yes | no | 6 + 3 | An accepted request is recorded; planning has not started. |
| `planning.idle` | `auto_wait` | yes | no | 6 + 3 | Planning is due; the controller allocates planning Work when a worker slot is free. |
| `planning.agent_running` | `work` | no | no | 10 + 2 | Planning Work is requested or running and will return a plan. |
| `planning.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 4 + 3 | Planning recovery or a budget is exhausted; a human corrects the cause and resumes. |
| `provisioning.idle` | `work` | yes | yes | 7 + 4 | The fork provisioning operation is planned or running through the trusted workflow. |
| `provisioning.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 3 + 4 | Provisioning cannot continue safely; a human corrects the prerequisite and resumes, or parks. |
| `development.agent_running` | `work` | no | yes | 10 + 3 | Patch Work is requested or running, or its verified Result is being published. |
| `development.waiting_ci` | `auto_wait` | no | yes | 10 + 3 | A patch is published to the development PR; CI and review evaluate the exact head. Passing CI nominates the head, or returns to `development.fix_needed` while actionable feedback is pending; passing CI behind an open operation keeps the contribution here. |
| `development.fix_needed` | `auto_wait` | yes | yes | 12 + 4 | Development Work is due: the fork is ready for a first patch, or a CI failure, actionable review, passing CI with feedback still pending, rejected proposal, refreshed plan, or a resume needs a bounded repair. It is the only state in which patch Work is requested, so none is requested before `confirm_provisioning`. |
| `development.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 6 + 4 | Development recovery or `work_total` is exhausted, the development PR does not match, or CI on the head was interrupted repeatedly; a human corrects the cause and resumes. |
| `handoff.awaiting_submission` | `gate` | no | no | 6 + 3 | Required CI passed on the exact head; a human may request upstream submission. |
| `handoff.review_due` | `auto_wait` | yes | no | 6 + 3 | The submission rewrite is due; the controller allocates rewrite Work when a worker slot is free. |
| `handoff.agent_running` | `work` | no | no | 6 + 2 | Submission rewrite Work is requested or running; its Result is the rewritten series, title, and description, or the reasons the series cannot be shaped without a code change. |
| `handoff.review_pending` | `auto_wait` | yes | no | 7 + 3 | The rewritten series passed the trusted check; its review is due, and the controller allocates review Work when a worker slot is free. |
| `handoff.reviewing` | `work` | no | no | 6 + 2 | Submission review Work is requested or running; its Result is pass or fail with reasons for exactly the rewritten series and text. |
| `handoff.building_upstream_branch` | `work` | no | yes | 6 + 2 | The upstream branch `riscv64` is created, or replaced under an exact-head lease, from the reviewed series, and read back. It is never written while an upstream PR is open from it, and `riscv64-dev` is not changed. |
| `handoff.waiting_ci` | `auto_wait` | no | no | 5 + 2 | Required CI runs on the clean head of `riscv64`. |
| `handoff.preparing_submission` | `work` | no | no | 3 + 2 | The submission package (title, body, prefilled compare link) is posted to the tracking issue. |
| `handoff.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 8 + 3 | A handoff step failed repeatedly or needs a human: the submission rewrite or review Work, writing `riscv64` (also while an upstream PR is open from it), CI on the clean head, or posting the submission package. A human corrects it and resumes; the resume returns to the step named by `pending_human_action` and starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter`. |
| `handoff.waiting_upstream_pr` | `locked` | no | no | 4 + 2 | Waiting for a human to open the upstream PR from the package. Exactly three exits leave it: `verify_upstream_pr`, `retract_submission`, and `refresh_planning`. |
| `upstream_review.waiting_ci` | `auto_wait` | no | no | 7 + 1 | The upstream PR is open; upstream CI, review, and merge are observed. Upstream CI is never rerun by the pipeline. |
| `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `auto_wait` | yes | yes | 8 + 2 | Upstream CI or actionable review needs a revision of the upstream PR head. |
| `upstream_review.agent_running` | `work` | no | yes | 9 + 1 | Revision Work for the upstream PR head is requested or running, or its verified Result is being published. |
| `upstream_review.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 6 + 3 | The upstream PR was closed unmerged, its head changed, a reviewer needs an answer, or recovery or a budget is exhausted; a human triages. |
| `release_wait.idle` | `auto_wait` | no | no | 3 + 1 | The upstream PR is merged; official release coverage is observed. |
| `release_wait.waiting_human` | `human_wait` | no | no | 1 + 2 | Release evidence needs operator action. |
| `released.idle` | `terminal` | no | no | 0 + 1 | Verified official release coverage satisfies the acceptance contract. |
| `parked.idle` | `generation_end` | no | no | 2 + 1 | The generation ended without success; a clean restart is possible. |
| `closed.idle` | `terminal` | no | no | 0 + 1 | No further work: withdrawn, not applicable, already satisfied, or abandoned. The reason is `terminal_reason`. |

An effect normally clears a whole field. These entries clear a part of one.

| Entry | Field | What is cleared |

| `carried pending_feedback_evidence_ids` | `pending_feedback_evidence_ids` | exactly the ids in `active_work.feedback_evidence_ids`, the pending feedback present when the Work was allocated; feedback recorded later stays pending |

## Rules

A rule is a transition that applies in many states. It is written once and expanded into one row per state; the rows appear under each state below, marked *(rule)*.

### `park_contribution`

Applies in every non-terminal state except `parked.idle`, `handoff.waiting_upstream_pr`, `release_wait.*`, and `upstream_review.*` other than `upstream_review.waiting_human`.

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `park_contribution` | command (`/upstreaming park`) | `parked.idle` | a reason is given; any revision, current or stale; no open operation. Ends the current generation; evidence is kept for audit. A Result held for publication is not published. Accepted while paused. | Work: clear; sets `parked_reason`, `previous_phase`; clears `pending_publication` | - |

Applies in every `provisioning.*` and `development.*` state.

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `resume_stale` | command (`/upstreaming resume`) | `queued.idle` | exact revision; paused, or waiting for a human; stopped for longer than `refresh.stale_after_days` days; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication; no requested Work. After a long stop the plan is refreshed: complete planning runs again while the fork and development PR are kept. The stop is counted from the older of `paused_at` and `pending_human_action.requested_at`. While an operation is open no resume applies, and the rejection names the open operation. From a human wait that an exhausted budget caused, it starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter`, like every resume. | revision +1; sets `refresh`; clears `plan_evidence_id`, `scope_coverage_complete`, `scope_paths`, `proposal_artifact`, `last_ci_evidence_id`, `clean_head_sha`, `handoff_request`, `handoff_approval`, `pending_human_action`, `publication_operation_id`, `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason`, `paused_by`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `operation_launch`, `interrupted_reruns`, `dispatch_recovery`, `work_recovery`, `work_total`, `publish_recovery`, `source_reads`) | - |

Applies in every state of kind `gate`, `human_wait`, or `locked`.

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `record_reminder` | tick | same state | at least `human_sla_business_days.reminder` business days since the request or the last reminder; not paused. Posts an append-only reminder of the pending human step. In `handoff.waiting_upstream_pr` the reminder text carries the package link and the exact head, and states when an observed PR does not match. | sets `pending_human_action.reminded_at` | - |

### `record_source_unavailable`

Applies in every state in which the controller needs the upstream base branch: `queued.idle`, `planning.idle`, `provisioning.idle`, `development.fix_needed`, `handoff.review_due`, `handoff.review_pending`, and `upstream_review.fix_needed`.

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `record_source_unavailable` | observation | same state | the upstream repository or its base branch could not be read, and the upstream did not say that the branch is missing; source_reads remains; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. A network error, a server error, a rate limit, or a repository that cannot be read: the contribution stays, and a later tick reads the upstream again. A failed read is charged only when it is the first of a run, or once the spacing (four fifths of `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` divided by `retries.source_unavailable_ticks`, so that a tick that comes a little early still counts) has passed since the last charged read; a failed read in between writes nothing, so a burst of ticks adds no events, and a read after a long pause counts once. A tick that reads the upstream starts `source_reads` again. | none | `source_reads` |

Expanded into: `queued.idle`, `planning.idle`, `provisioning.idle`, `development.fix_needed`, `handoff.review_due`, `handoff.review_pending`, `upstream_review.fix_needed`.

Applies in every state.

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `record_late_effect` | result | same state | the Result does not match the current generation, revision, and requested Work. Recorded in the events for audit. The Result is never folded, the publisher refuses it, and the state never changes. | none | - |

## Flags

A flag is stored beside the state. It is set and cleared from every non-terminal state and keeps phase and activity, except where noted.

### `paused`

Stored in `paused`. A stop of new Work and writer admission, with its reason and who set it (a human or the controller) in `paused_reason` and `paused_by`. `pause` accepts an optional reason; a pause set by the controller always records one: `pause_on_identity_change` names it in the table, and `pause_on_processing_error` records the error. Setting it clears the requested Work and the pending publication, and records `paused_at`; nothing held is published after the stop, and no publish retry is launched while paused. Phase, activity, evidence, and pending feedback are kept. The one exception: setting it in an `agent_running` state leads to the state in which the Work is due again, `planning.idle`, `development.fix_needed`, `handoff.review_due` (also from `handoff.reviewing`), or `upstream_review.fix_needed`. In `handoff.awaiting_submission` and `handoff.waiting_upstream_pr`, `resume_pause` keeps the plan, candidate head, clean head, `handoff_request`, and the posted package. `verify_upstream_pr` binds to the exact head only, so the revision bump does not invalidate the posted package; `submit_upstream` and `retract_submission` also name the exact revision, so after the bump they name the new revision with the same head, as the tracking-issue entries offer them.

| Verb | Sets or clears | Trigger | Guard | Effects |
|:-----|:---------------|:--------|:------|:--------|
| `pause` | sets | command (`/upstreaming pause`) | not paused; not terminal; any revision, current or stale. A reason is optional; when given it is recorded in `paused_reason`. | Work: clear; sets `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason`, `paused_by=human`; clears `pending_publication` |
| `pause_on_identity_change` | sets | observation | not paused; not terminal; the observed upstream repository identity differs from the recorded one | Work: clear; sets `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason=upstream_identity_changed`, `paused_by=controller`; clears `pending_publication` |
| `pause_on_processing_error` | sets | tick | not paused; not terminal; an unexpected error while the controller processed this contribution in the tick. Everything the tick staged for the contribution and every effect it requested for it are discarded first, so the stop is taken on the record as it was committed before the tick. `paused_reason` states the error class, the bounded and sanitized message, and the run id. The tick continues with the other contributions. A contribution that is already paused is not paused again. | Work: clear; sets `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason`, `paused_by=controller`; clears `pending_publication` |
| `resume_pause` | clears | command (`/upstreaming resume`) | paused; exact revision; stopped for at most `refresh.stale_after_days` days, or the phase is not provisioning or development. A Result that landed during the pause no longer matches and takes `record_late_effect`. In a human wait the resume clears the flag only: the reply states that the contribution still waits for a human and names the pending action, and a second resume leaves the wait. | revision +1; clears `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason`, `paused_by` |

Setting the flag clears the requested Work, so these states are left for the state in which that Work is due again:

| From | To |
|:-----|:---|
| `planning.agent_running` | `planning.idle` |
| `development.agent_running` | `development.fix_needed` |
| `handoff.agent_running` | `handoff.review_due` |
| `handoff.reviewing` | `handoff.review_due` |
| `upstream_review.agent_running` | `upstream_review.fix_needed` |

While set:

| Trigger | Effect |
|:--------|:-------|
| `command` | `resume`, `park`, `refresh`, `retract-pr`, `abandon`, and `resolve-operation` apply; other commands are rejected. `resume` clears the flag first: it takes `resume_pause` or `resume_stale`. In a human wait a second `resume` then leaves the wait. |
| `observation` | Folded normally, including CI on the exact head. |
| `result` | The requested Work and the pending publication were cleared, so a Result takes `record_late_effect`; nothing is published. |
| `operation` | Folded normally. The publisher's final check reads `paused`; an effect that passed it before the pause may finish. |
| `tick` | No launch, no Work allocation, no budget charge; reminders are suppressed. |

## Transitions

For each state, the verbs available from it. A verb leads from a state to one target only. *Same state* means the transition keeps phase and activity.

### `queued.idle`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `begin_planning` | tick | `planning.idle` | not paused | none | - |
| `withdraw_request` | observation | `closed.idle` | intake label removed; no Work requested; no plan; no fork | sets `terminal_reason=withdrawn` | - |
| `require_base_branch` | observation | `planning.waiting_human` | the upstream says that the base branch does not exist or was renamed; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Records whether the branch does not exist or was renamed, and to which name. While the contribution waits, the upstream is read again only once an authorized resume is posted. Once the branch exists again, a resume continues; to continue on another branch, the contribution is parked first and then restarted on that branch. | sets `pending_human_action=base_branch_unavailable` | - |
| `exhaust_source_reads` | observation | `planning.waiting_human` | source_reads exhausted: reads of the upstream kept failing for the whole retry window, most of them for the base branch; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Records how many failed reads were counted, since when, how many of them could not read the repository itself, and the last error. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once it can be read again the wait ends without a human (`resume_upstream_read`); a resume reads it again at once. | sets `pending_human_action=base_branch_unavailable`, `pending_human_action.counter=source_reads` | - |
| `require_upstream_access` | observation | `planning.waiting_human` | source_reads exhausted: reads of the upstream kept failing for the whole retry window, most of them for the repository itself; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once it can be read again the wait ends without a human (`resume_upstream_read`); a resume reads it again at once. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable`, `pending_human_action.counter=source_reads` | - |
| `require_renamed_upstream` | observation | `planning.waiting_human` | GitHub answers for the recorded upstream repository id under another name (renamed or transferred); not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Taken at once, with no counter: the answer cannot change by reading again. Records the repository and the name GitHub now gives it. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once GitHub answers for the same repository under its recorded name again the wait ends without a human (`resume_renamed_upstream`); a resume while it is still named otherwise waits again at once. A repository that moved is a new request: the contribution is parked, then abandoned. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable` | - |
| `park_contribution` (rule) | command (`/upstreaming park`) | `parked.idle` | a reason is given; any revision, current or stale; no open operation. ### `planning.agent_running`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `retry_dispatch` | tick | same state | a dispatcher run ended with the requested Work absent or unclaimed; dispatch_recovery remains. Launches the dispatcher again for the same committed Work request. | none | `dispatch_recovery` |

Once the branch exists again, a resume continues; to continue on another branch, the contribution is parked first and then restarted on that branch. | sets `pending_human_action=base_branch_unavailable` | - |
| `exhaust_source_reads` | observation | `provisioning.waiting_human` | source_reads exhausted: reads of the upstream kept failing for the whole retry window, most of them for the base branch; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once it can be read again the wait ends without a human (`resume_upstream_read`); a resume reads it again at once. | sets `pending_human_action=base_branch_unavailable`, `pending_human_action.counter=source_reads` | - |
| `require_upstream_access` | observation | `provisioning.waiting_human` | source_reads exhausted: reads of the upstream kept failing for the whole retry window, most of them for the repository itself; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Taken once failed reads of the repository itself are the majority of the retry window (deleted, made private, or no longer readable with the token). Records the repository and the counted reads. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once it can be read again the wait ends without a human (`resume_upstream_read`); a resume reads it again at once. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable`, `pending_human_action.counter=source_reads` | - |
| `require_renamed_upstream` | observation | `provisioning.waiting_human` | GitHub answers for the recorded upstream repository id under another name (renamed or transferred); not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Taken at once, with no counter: the answer cannot change by reading again. Records the repository and the name GitHub now gives it. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once GitHub answers for the same repository under its recorded name again the wait ends without a human (`resume_renamed_upstream`); a resume while it is still named otherwise waits again at once. A repository that moved is a new request: the contribution is parked, then abandoned. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable` | - |

| `resume_stale` (rule) | command (`/upstreaming resume`) | `queued.idle` | exact revision; paused, or waiting for a human; stopped for longer than `refresh.stale_after_days` days; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication; no requested Work. After a long stop the plan is refreshed: complete planning runs again while the fork and development PR are kept. The stop is counted from the older of `paused_at` and `pending_human_action.requested_at`. While an operation is open no resume applies, and the rejection names the open operation. From a human wait that an exhausted budget caused, it starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter`, like every resume. | revision +1; sets `refresh`; clears `plan_evidence_id`, `scope_coverage_complete`, `scope_paths`, `proposal_artifact`, `last_ci_evidence_id`, `clean_head_sha`, `handoff_request`, `handoff_approval`, `pending_human_action`, `publication_operation_id`, `paused`, `paused_at`, `paused_reason`, `paused_by`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `operation_launch`, `interrupted_reruns`, `dispatch_recovery`, `work_recovery`, `work_total`, `publish_recovery`, `source_reads`) | - |
| `record_source_unavailable` (rule) | observation | same state | the upstream repository or its base branch could not be read, and the upstream did not say that the branch is missing; source_reads remains; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. A network error, a server error, a rate limit, or a repository that cannot be read: the contribution stays, and a later tick reads the upstream again. A failed read is charged only when it is the first of a run, or once the spacing (four fifths of `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` divided by `retries.source_unavailable_ticks`, so that a tick that comes a little early still counts) has passed since the last charged read; a failed read in between writes nothing, so a burst of ticks adds no events, and a read after a long pause counts once. A tick that reads the upstream starts `source_reads` again. | none | `source_reads` |
| `record_late_effect` (rule) | result | same state | the Result does not match the current generation, revision, and requested Work. Recorded in the events for audit. The Result is never folded, the publisher refuses it, and the state never changes. | none | - |

Taken once failed reads of the repository itself are the majority of the retry window (deleted, made private, or no longer readable with the token). Records the repository and the counted reads. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once it can be read again the wait ends without a human (`resume_upstream_read`); a resume reads it again at once. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable`, `pending_human_action.counter=source_reads` | - |
| `require_renamed_upstream` | observation | `handoff.waiting_human` | GitHub answers for the recorded upstream repository id under another name (renamed or transferred); not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. The upstream is still read on every tick, and once GitHub answers for the same repository under its recorded name again the wait ends without a human (`resume_renamed_upstream`); a resume while it is still named otherwise waits again at once. A repository that moved is a new request: the contribution is parked, then abandoned. | sets `pending_human_action=upstream_unavailable` | - |
| `park_contribution` (rule) | command (`/upstreaming park`) | `parked.idle` | a reason is given; any revision, current or stale; no open operation. Ends the current generation; evidence is kept for audit. A Result held for publication is not published. Accepted while paused. | Work: clear; sets `parked_reason`, `previous_phase`; clears `pending_publication` | - |
| `record_source_unavailable` (rule) | observation | same state | the upstream repository or its base branch could not be read, and the upstream did not say that the branch is missing; source_reads remains; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. A network error, a server error, a rate limit, or a repository that cannot be read: the contribution stays, and a later tick reads the upstream again. A failed read is charged only when it is the first of a run, or once the spacing (four fifths of `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` divided by `retries.source_unavailable_ticks`, so that a tick that comes a little early still counts) has passed since the last charged read; a failed read in between writes nothing, so a burst of ticks adds no events, and a read after a long pause counts once. A tick that reads the upstream starts `source_reads` again. | none | `source_reads` |
| `record_late_effect` (rule) | result | same state | the Result does not match the current generation, revision, and requested Work. Recorded in the events for audit. The Result is never folded, the publisher refuses it, and the state never changes. | none | - |

A publication whose push was not read back (`uncertain`) does not take this row: it is a failed publication (`schedule_publish_retry`), and the publish-only retry reads back the head a lost push left without pushing again. | revision +1; Work: clear; sets `proposal_artifact`, `publication_operation_id`, `upstream_pr.head_sha`; clears `carried pending_feedback_evidence_ids` | - |
| `reject_patch_proposal` | result | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | the proposal is rejected for the current revision, or the worker reports it is blocked; no_progress remains. The pending feedback is kept. | revision +1; Work: clear | `no_progress` |
| `require_reviewer_answer` | result | `upstream_review.waiting_human` | the worker reports that no change is needed. A human answers the reviewer; the pipeline posts nothing on the upstream PR. | Work: clear; sets `pending_human_action=answer_reviewer` | - |
| `schedule_publish_retry` | result | same state | publication failed with an infrastructure error; publish_recovery remains. The same verified Result is published again; no new Work is requested. The pending publication carries the feedback ids of its Work. A publication whose push was not read back (`uncertain`) is such a failure; the retry reads the branch first and never pushes over a push that landed. | Work: clear; sets `pending_publication` | `publish_recovery` |
| `exhaust_publish_recovery` | result | `upstream_review.waiting_human` | publish_recovery exhausted | sets `pending_human_action=publication_infrastructure_failure`, `pending_human_action.counter=publish_recovery`, `pending_publication.exhausted` | - |
| `retry_dispatch` | tick | same state | a dispatcher run ended with the requested Work absent or unclaimed; dispatch_recovery remains. Launches the dispatcher again for the same committed Work request. | none | `dispatch_recovery` |
| `exhaust_dispatch_recovery` | tick | `upstream_review.waiting_human` | dispatch_recovery exhausted | Work: clear; sets `pending_human_action=dispatch_failed`, `pending_human_action.counter=dispatch_recovery` | - |
| `allocate_work_retry` | tick | same state | the Work graph is terminal without a usable Result; work_recovery and work_total remain; upstream identity and base bound. A terminal Work graph is never submitted again; a fresh graph is allocated. It carries the same feedback ids. | revision +1; Work: reallocate | `work_recovery`, `work_total` |
| `exhaust_work_recovery` | tick | `upstream_review.waiting_human` | the Work graph is terminal without a usable Result; work_recovery or work_total exhausted. `pending_human_action.counter` names `work_total` when that budget is exhausted, and `work_recovery` otherwise. | Work: clear; sets `pending_human_action=work_failed`, `pending_human_action.counter` | - |
| `record_late_effect` (rule) | result | same state | the Result does not match the current generation, revision, and requested Work. Recorded in the events for audit. The Result is never folded, the publisher refuses it, and the state never changes. | none | - |

### `upstream_review.waiting_human`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `resume_upstream_review` | command (`/upstreaming resume`) | `upstream_review.waiting_ci` | exact revision; pending_human_action is pr_closed_unmerged, answer_reviewer, or upstream_head_changed; for pr_closed_unmerged, the upstream PR is observed open again. No revision Work is requested. The pending feedback is cleared when the pending action is `answer_reviewer`, because a human answered it; the other two pending actions hold none. | revision +1; clears `pending_human_action`, `pending_feedback_evidence_ids` | - |
| `rearm_dispatch` | tick | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | pending_human_action is dispatch_failed; the work-queue Policy was installed after the dispatch failed, and the compiled policy preserves it; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Re-arms a dispatch that failed while the installed work-queue Policy refused every dispatch, once the dispatcher has reinstalled the compiled policy: the same transition as the resume a human would post, taken by the controller. | revision +1; clears `pending_human_action`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `dispatch_recovery`) | - |
| `resume_upstream_revision` | command (`/upstreaming resume`) | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | exact revision; pending_human_action is dispatch_failed, work_failed, publication_infrastructure_failure, repair_budget_exhausted, base_branch_unavailable, or upstream_unavailable. Only when revision Work failed: dispatch, Work, publication, or a budget. The pending feedback is kept. When an exhausted budget caused the wait, the resume starts again the one counter named in `pending_human_action.counter`, and no other. The event records the actor, the counter, and its count at that point. | revision +1; clears `pending_human_action`, `pending_publication`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `repair_attempts_cluster`, `no_progress`, `work_total`, `dispatch_recovery`, `work_recovery`, `publish_recovery`, `source_reads`) | - |
| `resume_upstream_read` | tick | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | pending_human_action is base_branch_unavailable or upstream_unavailable; the wait was entered because reads kept failing, not because the upstream said that the branch is missing; the upstream repository and its base branch are read again; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Ends a wait that failed reads caused once a tick reads the upstream again: the step that was due runs again, and the tracking issue states that the contribution continues. A wait the upstream's own answer caused (a missing or renamed branch) still needs a resume. | revision +1; clears `pending_human_action`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `source_reads`) | - |
| `resume_renamed_upstream` | tick | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | pending_human_action is upstream_unavailable; the wait was entered because GitHub named the recorded repository otherwise: its pending action names no counter; the upstream repository and its base branch are read again; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. Ends the wait a renamed repository caused once a tick reads the repository under its recorded name and id again: the step that was due runs again, and the tracking issue states that the contribution continues. | revision +1; clears `pending_human_action`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `source_reads`) | - |
| `resume_renamed_base` | observation | `upstream_review.fix_needed` | pending_human_action is base_branch_unavailable; the upstream renamed the base branch, the open upstream PR now targets the new name, and the new name's history contains the recorded base commit; not paused; quiescent: no open operation and no pending publication. The wait a renamed base branch caused ends without a human: the record follows the rename as `follow_renamed_base` does, and the revision Work that was due is due again. The tracking issue states the rename. | revision +1; sets `upstream.base_ref`, `upstream_pr.base_ref`; clears `pending_human_action`; starts again the counter named in `pending_human_action.counter` (one of `source_reads`) | - |
| `park_contribution` (rule) | command (`/upstreaming park`) | `parked.idle` | a reason is given; any revision, current or stale; no open operation. Ends the current generation; evidence is kept for audit. A Result held for publication is not published. Accepted while paused. | Work: clear; sets `parked_reason`, `previous_phase`; clears `pending_publication` | - |
| `record_reminder` (rule) | tick | same state | at least `human_sla_business_days.reminder` business days since the request or the last reminder; not paused. Posts an append-only reminder of the pending human step. In `handoff.waiting_upstream_pr` the reminder text carries the package link and the exact head, and states when an observed PR does not match. | sets `pending_human_action.reminded_at` | - |
| `record_late_effect` (rule) | result | same state | the Result does not match the current generation, revision, and requested Work. Recorded in the events for audit. The Result is never folded, the publisher refuses it, and the state never changes. | none | - |

## Budgets

Each budget counts charges by the verbs that name it. Its limit is a `policy.json` value, plus one when the first try is free. When the count reaches the limit, an exhaustion verb is taken instead. Exhaustion of an infrastructure budget always leads to a human wait of the same phase. Every exhaustion that leads to a human wait names its counter in `pending_human_action.counter`, and the resume from that wait starts exactly that counter again, and no other.

| Budget | One charge | Counter | Limit | Infrastructure | Charged by | Exhaustion |
|:-------|:-----------|:--------|:------|:---------------|:-----------|:-----------|
| `work_total` | one Work allocation of any kind | `budget.attempts_used`, counted per generation | `retries.max_attempts_per_contribution` (24) | no | `allocate_work_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `handoff.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `handoff.reviewing`; `allocate_work_retry` from `planning.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running`; `dispatch_planning` from `planning.idle`; `request_patch` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_repair` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_review_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed`; `request_submission_review` from `handoff.review_pending`; `request_submission_rewrite` from `handoff.review_due`; `request_upstream_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `exhaust_work_total`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_total`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_total`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_total`: `handoff.review_pending` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `handoff.reviewing` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `work_recovery` | one fresh Work graph after terminal Work without a usable Result | `active_work.attempt` | 1 + `retries.work_recovery` (2) = 3 | yes | `allocate_work_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `handoff.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `handoff.reviewing`; `allocate_work_retry` from `planning.agent_running`; `allocate_work_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_work_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `handoff.reviewing` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_work_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `planning_attempts` | one planning Result without a usable plan | `budget.planning_attempts` | `retries.planning_attempts` (3) | no | `reject_plan` from `planning.agent_running` | `exhaust_planning_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human` |
| `repair_attempts_cluster` | one repair or revision Work allocation for one failing CI job; Work that is due without a failing CI job charges none | `budget.clusters[<job>]`, started again by `refresh_on_exhaustion` | `retries.patch_attempts_per_cluster` (3) | no | `request_repair` from `development.fix_needed`; `request_upstream_revision` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `refresh_on_exhaustion`: `development.fix_needed` to `queued.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `development.fix_needed` to `parked.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `no_progress` | one successive rejected or blocked outcome without progress | `budget.no_progress_streak`, started again by a published patch and by `refresh_on_exhaustion` | `retries.no_progress_review_after` (2) | no | `reject_patch_proposal` from `development.agent_running`; `reject_patch_proposal` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `refresh_on_exhaustion`: `development.fix_needed` to `queued.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `development.fix_needed` to `parked.idle`; `exhaust_repair_attempts`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `flaky_reruns` | one rerun of the failed CI jobs on the exact head, requested by the repair worker | `budget.reruns.flaky`, counted for the head in `budget.reruns.head_sha` and started again whenever the recorded head changes | `retries.flaky_reruns` (1) | no | `request_ci_rerun` from `development.agent_running` | `reject_patch_proposal`: `development.agent_running` to `development.fix_needed` |
| `interrupted_reruns` | one rerun by the collector of CI jobs that were cancelled or lost their runner | `budget.reruns.interrupted`, counted for the head in `budget.reruns.head_sha` and started again whenever the recorded head changes and by `resume_ci` | `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) | yes | `rerun_interrupted_ci` from `development.waiting_ci`; `rerun_interrupted_ci` from `handoff.waiting_ci` | `exhaust_interrupted_reruns`: `development.waiting_ci` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_interrupted_reruns`: `handoff.waiting_ci` to `handoff.waiting_human` |
| `dispatch_recovery` | one dispatcher run that ended with the requested Work absent or unclaimed | dispatcher runs since `active_work.requested_at` | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_dispatch` from `development.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `handoff.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `handoff.reviewing`; `retry_dispatch` from `planning.agent_running`; `retry_dispatch` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_dispatch_recovery`: `planning.agent_running` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_dispatch_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_dispatch_recovery`: `handoff.agent_running` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_dispatch_recovery`: `handoff.reviewing` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_dispatch_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `publish_recovery` | one publish-only retry of the same verified Result | `pending_publication.attempts` | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `schedule_publish_retry` from `development.agent_running`; `schedule_publish_retry` from `upstream_review.agent_running` | `exhaust_publish_recovery`: `development.agent_running` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_publish_recovery`: `upstream_review.agent_running` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `source_reads` | one failed read of the upstream repository or base branch without a definitive answer, counted at most once per spacing (four fifths of `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` divided by `retries.source_unavailable_ticks`) | `budget.source_unavailable`, the counted failed reads, since `budget.source_unavailable_since`, the last at `budget.source_unavailable_at`, of which `budget.source_unavailable_repository` could not read the repository itself: a tick that reads the upstream starts it again. It is exhausted only once both the count is reached and `retries.source_unavailable_minutes` minutes have passed since the first failed read | `retries.source_unavailable_ticks` (12) | no | `record_source_unavailable` from `development.fix_needed`; `record_source_unavailable` from `handoff.review_due`; `record_source_unavailable` from `handoff.review_pending`; `record_source_unavailable` from `planning.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `provisioning.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `queued.idle`; `record_source_unavailable` from `upstream_review.fix_needed` | `exhaust_source_reads`: `queued.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `queued.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `planning.idle` to `planning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `development.fix_needed` to `development.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `handoff.review_due` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `handoff.review_pending` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `handoff.review_pending` to `handoff.waiting_human`; `exhaust_source_reads`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human`; `require_upstream_access`: `upstream_review.fix_needed` to `upstream_review.waiting_human` |
| `operation_launch` | one launch of a planned fork provisioning operation | the operation's launch attempts | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `start_operation` from `provisioning.idle` | `require_provisioning_intervention`: `provisioning.idle` to `provisioning.waiting_human` |
| `upstream_branch` | one lease write and readback of `riscv64` | the handoff operation's attempts | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_upstream_branch` from `handoff.building_upstream_branch` | `exhaust_upstream_branch_retries`: `handoff.building_upstream_branch` to `handoff.waiting_human` |
| `submission_comment` | one attempt to post the submission package | the handoff operation's attempts | 1 + `retries.infrastructure_per_head_failure` (2) = 3 | yes | `retry_submission_comment` from `handoff.preparing_submission` | `exhaust_comment_retries`: `handoff.preparing_submission` to `handoff.waiting_human` |

Two more limits are read from `policy.json`: `refresh.stale_after_days` (7) is the length of a stop after which `resume_stale` applies, and `human_sla_business_days.reminder` (3) is the interval of `record_reminder`.

## Operation table

Every remote effect is an operation with its own small table, held to the same checks. The intent is recorded before the effect, and the receipt is confirmed by discovering the actual resource. While an operation is open (`planned`, `applying`, `uncertain`) it fences its contribution: no park, no refresh, and no second writer. `/upstreaming resolve-operation` closes an open operation with a resolution evidence record.

An operation starts in `planned` (`record_intent`).

| State | Open | Exits | Description |
|:------|:-----|:------|:------------|
| `planned` | yes | 4 | The intent is recorded; the remote effect has not been attempted. |
| `applying` | yes | 5 | The remote call is in flight. |
| `uncertain` | yes | 5 | The effect may or may not exist; it is discovered, never repeated. |
| `confirmed` | no | 0 | The effect exists and was read back. |
| `failed` | no | 0 | The effect definitely did not succeed. |
| `not_launched` | no | 0 | A human established with evidence that the effect was never launched. |

### Operation `planned`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `begin_effect` | tick | `applying` | capacity available; the contribution is not paused; the final check before the effect passes | none | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `applying`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `record_response` | operation | `uncertain` | the remote call succeeded, or its response was lost or ambiguous. Even a successful response is provisional until discovery confirms the resource. | sets `external_ids` | - |
| `record_failure` | operation | `failed` | the remote call returned a definite failure | sets `external_ids` | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `uncertain`

| Verb | Trigger | To | Guard | Effects | Charges |
|:-----|:--------|:---|:------|:--------|:--------|
| `confirm_by_discovery` | operation | `confirmed` | discovery finds the exact resource the operation proposed | sets `discovery` | - |
| `record_discovery` | operation | same state | discovery finds the resource absent or an unrelated one. Absence never proves that the effect did not launch, and elapsed time never closes an operation. | sets `discovery` | - |
| `resolve_confirmed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `confirmed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition confirmed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_failed` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `failed` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition failed | sets `resolution` | - |
| `resolve_not_launched` | command (`/upstreaming resolve-operation`) | `not_launched` | the command names this operation; a resolution evidence record states the disposition; disposition not-launched | sets `resolution` | - |

### Operation `confirmed`

End state: no transition leaves it.

### Operation `failed`

End state: no transition leaves it.

### Operation `not_launched`

End state: no transition leaves it.
